name: Leaf Blast
symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions on leaves, neck rot, and drying patches under humid conditions.
cause: Fungal infection favored by high humidity, excess nitrogen, and dense crop canopies.
treatment: Remove heavily infected leaves, keep fields airy, and apply a recommended fungicide if disease pressure is high.
prevention: Use resistant varieties, balanced nitrogen, and clean seed.
recommended_fungicide: Follow local extension guidance for tricyclazole or another locally approved fungicide.
organic_solution: Support plants with silica-rich nutrition and biological control practices as part of integrated management.
farmer_tips: Avoid overwatering and inspect fields after heavy dew or rain.
fertilizer_recommendation: Reduce excess nitrogen and keep potassium adequate.

name: Brown Spot
symptoms: Oval brown lesions with darker edges that may merge and reduce leaf area.
cause: Fungal disease often linked to poor soil fertility and plant stress.
treatment: Improve nutrition, sanitize crop residues, and apply a fungicide when necessary.
prevention: Use balanced fertilization and healthy seed.
recommended_fungicide: Use a locally recommended fungicide according to label directions.
organic_solution: Biological sprays and compost-based nutrition can support recovery.
farmer_tips: Check soil potassium and avoid stressing the crop during dry spells.
fertilizer_recommendation: Increase balanced NPK nutrition with soil-test guidance.

name: Bacterial Blight
symptoms: Yellow to white leaf stripes, wilting, and drying of leaf tips in severe cases.
cause: Bacterial infection spread by rain splash, wind, and infected plant material.
treatment: Remove infected debris and use approved bactericide guidance from local experts.
prevention: Use resistant varieties and avoid excess nitrogen.
recommended_fungicide: Bacterial disease management should follow local recommendations, as fungicides are often not effective.
organic_solution: Use bio-control and sanitation practices to reduce spread.
farmer_tips: Reduce plant stress and avoid injuries during field operations.
fertilizer_recommendation: Use modest nitrogen with strong potassium support.

name: Healthy
symptoms: Green, upright leaves with no visible lesions or major discoloration.
cause: Crop is currently showing good health.
treatment: Keep monitoring irrigation, nutrition, and pest pressure.
prevention: Maintain balanced crop care and field sanitation.
recommended_fungicide: No fungicide needed when the crop is healthy.
organic_solution: Continue using compost and biological support as a preventive practice.
farmer_tips: Regular scouting is the best way to stay ahead of problems.
